speaker: io
say: We’re closer, Kore. I can feel it pulling.
words_shown: We’re closer, Kore. I can feel it pulling.
tone: Low, a hand on her chest. Not quite afraid.

speaker: io
say: Then we’re going the wrong way.
words_shown: Then we’re going the wrong way.
tone: A small smile. She knows, and goes anyway.

speaker: io
say: Nobody’s tended these. You can tell.
words_shown: Nobody’s tended these. You can tell.

speaker: io
say: Eldergrove. I used to pray to it, from home.
words_shown: Eldergrove. I used to pray to it, from home.
tone: Hushed and glad, a child seeing a church she only knew by name.

speaker: io
say: It still answers me. Even here.
words_shown: It still answers me. Even here.

speaker: io
say: The oldest letter I carry is to my sister. I’ve never read it back.
words_shown: The oldest letter I carry is to my sister. I’ve never read it back.
tone: Low, by the fire. She has never said this aloud.

speaker: io
say: No. It’s for her.
words_shown: No. It’s for her.

speaker: io
say: Kore, she’s wearing Warden steel.
words_shown: Kore, she’s wearing Warden steel.

speaker: io
say: She used my prayers. Every one. And she stopped when I answered.
words_shown: She used my prayers. Every one. And she stopped when I answered.
tone: Shaken, working it out as she speaks.

speaker: io
say: Kore. She walks the way I walk.
words_shown: Kore. She walks the way I walk.
tone: Barely a whisper. She does not dare finish the thought.

speaker: io
say: What was her name?
words_shown: What was her name?
tone: Barely a breath. She already knows.

speaker: io
say: Alive. Kore, she’s alive.
words_shown: Alive. Kore, she’s alive.

speaker: io
say: It’s enough. It’s more than I had.
words_shown: It’s enough. It’s more than I had.
tone: Fierce and soft at once. Holding on with both hands.

speaker: io
say: Eight years I wrote to her. She was just up the road.
words_shown: Eight years I wrote to her. She was just up the road.
tone: Rueful, almost a laugh, almost not.

speaker: io
say: I’m bringing her home, Kore.
words_shown: I’m bringing her home, Kore.

speaker: kore
say: Everything leans north-east up here. Even the trees. Rude.
words_shown: Everything leans north-east up here. Even the trees. Rude.
tone: Mock offended, to keep everyone light.

speaker: kore
say: Then hold on to something. Not it.
words_shown: Then hold on to something. Not it.
tone: Quick and serious, taking her hand.

speaker: kore
say: Everyone here is buying a way out. Nobody’s buying a way in.
words_shown: Everyone here is buying a way out. Nobody’s buying a way in.
tone: Light, with a true thing in it.

speaker: kore
say: We usually are, Io.
words_shown: We usually are, Io.
tone: Fond, a shrug in the voice.

speaker: kore
say: Then let’s tend them. Briskly.
words_shown: Then let’s tend them. Briskly.

speaker: kore
say: Good. Somewhere that hasn’t been asked.
words_shown: Good. Somewhere that hasn’t been asked.

speaker: kore
say: Read it to me.
words_shown: Read it to me.

speaker: kore
say: Then keep it safe. I’ll keep you safe.
words_shown: Then keep it safe. I’ll keep you safe.
tone: Light words, a vow under them.

speaker: kore
say: Behind me, Io. Now.
words_shown: Behind me, Io. Now.

speaker: kore
say: She has no ending, Io. I tried. There’s nothing there to seal.
words_shown: She has no ending, Io. I tried. There’s nothing there to seal.
tone: Frightened, for the first time. Quiet.

speaker: kore
say: [quietly] She’s held, Io. That isn’t the same.
words_shown: She’s held, Io. That isn’t the same.
tone: Gentle. It hurts her to say it.

speaker: kore
say: And I go first.
words_shown: And I go first.

speaker: kore
say: You couldn’t have known, Io.
words_shown: You couldn’t have known, Io.

speaker: europa
say: The threads up here hum when you touch them.
words_shown: The threads up here hum when you touch them.

speaker: europa
say: Your sails are a disgrace, captain. I’ll mend them for nothing.
words_shown: Your sails are a disgrace, captain. I’ll mend them for nothing.

speaker: europa
say: Moon-silk sails. I want to touch every one.
words_shown: Moon-silk sails. I want to touch every one.

speaker: europa
say: No thread on it. Nothing’s pulling. It just grew.
words_shown: No thread on it. Nothing’s pulling. It just grew.

speaker: europa
say: Every thread here is green. Not one goes north.
words_shown: Every thread here is green. Not one goes north.

speaker: europa
say: It knows you, Io. Look, the leaves turn when you speak.
words_shown: It knows you, Io. Look, the leaves turn when you speak.

speaker: europa
say: Hold still, Callisto. Your cloak’s torn again.
words_shown: Hold still, Callisto. Your cloak’s torn again.

speaker: europa
say: Her threads all run north. She’s sewn in.
words_shown: Her threads all run north. She’s sewn in.
tone: Grim, for once with no play in it.

speaker: europa
say: Whoever she is, someone tied her very tight.
words_shown: Whoever she is, someone tied her very tight.

speaker: europa
say: And I’m bringing my scissors.
words_shown: And I’m bringing my scissors.

speaker: europa
say: The shipmaster’s waving. The moon-folk don’t wave.
words_shown: The shipmaster’s waving. The moon-folk don’t wave.

speaker: callisto
say: Ice on the brambles. And the brambles are taller than me.
words_shown: Ice on the brambles. And the brambles are taller than me.
tone: Quiet, measuring them with her eye.

speaker: callisto
say: Ships leaving. None coming.
words_shown: Ships leaving. None coming.

speaker: callisto
say: That bramble moved.
words_shown: That bramble moved.

speaker: callisto
say: Something big moved in the trees. It’s watching Io.
words_shown: Something big moved in the trees. It’s watching Io.

speaker: callisto
say: It tore itself.
words_shown: It tore itself.
tone: Deadpan. The nearest she comes to a joke.

speaker: callisto
say: Sleep. I’ll watch.
words_shown: Sleep. I’ll watch.
tone: Calm, settling her bow across her knees.

speaker: callisto
say: Wait. Something on the road. All light.
words_shown: Wait. Something on the road. All light.
tone: Sharp and low, the first to see.

speaker: callisto
say: She looked back. Once.
words_shown: She looked back. Once.

speaker: callisto
say: Thank you.
words_shown: Thank you.
tone: Quiet and formal. A princess thanking a stranger for a hard gift.

speaker: callisto
say: Then we go and get her.
words_shown: Then we go and get her.

speaker: callisto
say: Peaks ahead. Snow on all of them.
words_shown: Peaks ahead. Snow on all of them.

speaker: captain
say: Raiders again. Bigger ship this time. Hold on.
words_shown: Raiders again. Bigger ship this time. Hold on.
tone: Clipped and tense, steady at the wheel.

speaker: captain
say: Seen off. My hands are shaking. That’s the cold.
words_shown: Seen off. My hands are shaking. That’s the cold.
tone: Dry. It is not the cold.

speaker: captain
say: Northern camp. Colder than a creditor. She needs work before she’ll go further.
words_shown: Northern camp. Colder than a creditor. She needs work before she’ll go further.

speaker: captain
say: There’s a shipyard down the coast. The moon-folk run it. They’ll fleece me.
words_shown: There’s a shipyard down the coast. The moon-folk run it. They’ll fleece me.

speaker: captain
say: Tock says she needs new ribs. I said she needs nothing. We’re both right.
words_shown: Tock says she needs new ribs. I said she needs nothing. We’re both right.

speaker: captain
say: The shipmaster offered to buy her. A great deal of money. No.
words_shown: The shipmaster offered to buy her. A great deal of money. No.

speaker: captain
say: She’s offered four times. I keep saying no. Don’t ask me why.
words_shown: She’s offered four times. I keep saying no. Don’t ask me why.

speaker: captain
say: The north road goes past Eldergrove to the crossroads. Nobody uses it after dark.
words_shown: The north road goes past Eldergrove to the crossroads. Nobody uses it after dark.
tone: Low, giving directions he does not like.

speaker: captain
say: I saw the light from here. Whatever met you on that road, it lit the clouds.
words_shown: I saw the light from here. Whatever met you on that road, it lit the clouds.
tone: Shaken, trying not to show it.

speaker: captain
say: Refit’s done. She’ll fly higher. Not high enough for where you’re going, I think.
words_shown: Refit’s done. She’ll fly higher. Not high enough for where you’re going, I think.

speaker: captain
say: North-east, then. Into the peaks. I’ll take you as far as a flame will burn.
words_shown: North-east, then. Into the peaks. I’ll take you as far as a flame will burn.
tone: Steady. A promise with a limit in it.

speaker: captain
say: Won, by the look. Tock will want to know if you need patching. Tell him no.
words_shown: Won, by the look. Tock will want to know if you need patching. Tell him no.

speaker: captain
say: You look like my hull did. Sit. Tock can’t mend people, more’s the pity.
words_shown: You look like my hull did. Sit. Tock can’t mend people, more’s the pity.

speaker: captain
say: Mind the slipway. It’s greasy.
words_shown: Mind the slipway. It’s greasy.

speaker: captain
say: The lean’s worse up here. Pennant’s nearly flat out. North-east, always.
words_shown: The lean’s worse up here. Pennant’s nearly flat out. North-east, always.
tone: Uneasy, squinting up at the mast.

speaker: captain
say: So now you know whose light it is. I’m sorry, Io. Or I’m glad. I can’t tell.
words_shown: So now you know whose light it is. I’m sorry, Io. Or I’m glad. I can’t tell.

speaker: ysmera
say: Passage south, by the berth, paid before boarding. The north is not for sale.
words_shown: Passage south, by the berth, paid before boarding. The north is not for sale.
tone: Brisk and cool. A shopkeeper who has said it a thousand times.

speaker: ysmera
say: My people have watched a great many lands go dark. We are very good at leaving.
words_shown: My people have watched a great many lands go dark. We are very good at leaving.
tone: Dry and elegant, with a sadness she would never admit.

speaker: ysmera
say: Your captain’s at the slip with Tock, arguing. Down by the water.
words_shown: Your captain’s at the slip with Tock, arguing. Down by the water.
tone: Mildly amused, a hand toward the water.

speaker: ysmera
say: The cold lights look late for something. My people are never late. It’s rather rude.
words_shown: The cold lights look late for something. My people are never late. It’s rather rude.
tone: Disdainful and puzzled. Held as a guess.

speaker: ysmera
say: The last berths go for a fortune. Grief pays well. I wish it didn’t.
words_shown: The last berths go for a fortune. Grief pays well. I wish it didn’t.
tone: Cool, then a crack on the last sentence.

speaker: ysmera
say: You want to know about the north. Everyone who asks that has stopped buying passage.
words_shown: You want to know about the north. Everyone who asks that has stopped buying passage.

speaker: ysmera
say: No. I won’t talk about the north. Ask me again when you’ve been.
words_shown: No. I won’t talk about the north. Ask me again when you’ve been.

speaker: ysmera
say: Something walks the north road at night, all light. My sailors won’t go past the crossroads.
words_shown: Something walks the north road at night, all light. My sailors won’t go past the crossroads.
tone: Low and unwilling. She says more than she meant to.

speaker: ysmera
say: Eight years ago a paladin came through my yard with forty Wardens behind her.
words_shown: Eight years ago a paladin came through my yard with forty Wardens behind her.

speaker: ysmera
say: She paid in Warden’s silver and asked for nothing back. Not even a passage home.
words_shown: She paid in Warden’s silver and asked for nothing back. Not even a passage home.

speaker: ysmera
say: Halcyon.
words_shown: Halcyon.
tone: One word, gently. Let it land.

speaker: ysmera
say: There’s a berth on my last ship with your names on it. In case.
words_shown: There’s a berth on my last ship with your names on it. In case.
tone: Offhand, as if it cost nothing. It costs a great deal.

speaker: ysmera
say: Go north, then. My people never go back for anything. I find I’d like you to.
words_shown: Go north, then. My people never go back for anything. I find I’d like you to.
tone: Elegant, and for once not quite steady.

speaker: ysmera
say: I’ve sold every berth but one. I find I don’t want it. I’m staying.
words_shown: I’ve sold every berth but one. I find I don’t want it. I’m staying.

speaker: ysmera
say: Your captain refused my offer for his ship. Four times. I made the last one generous.
words_shown: Your captain refused my offer for his ship. Four times. I made the last one generous.

speaker: ysmera
say: The woman by the dock has bought her passage three times. She keeps not going.
words_shown: The woman by the dock has bought her passage three times. She keeps not going.
tone: Puzzled, with a trace of fondness.

speaker: ysmera
say: Tock says your ship has a good keel and a terrible captain. That’s praise, from Tock.
words_shown: Tock says your ship has a good keel and a terrible captain. That’s praise, from Tock.

speaker: ysmera
say: You’ve been fighting. Your boots say so. Clean them before you walk on my deck.
words_shown: You’ve been fighting. Your boots say so. Clean them before you walk on my deck.
tone: Fastidious, with a flicker of approval.

speaker: ysmera
say: Sit down before you fall down. My people find falling undignified.
words_shown: Sit down before you fall down. My people find falling undignified.
tone: Cool concern, dressed up as manners.

speaker: ysmera
say: You look expensive to replace, all four. Be careful.
words_shown: You look expensive to replace, all four. Be careful.

speaker: ysmera
say: You’ve the look of people who won’t need passage. I’ve seen it once before.
words_shown: You’ve the look of people who won’t need passage. I’ve seen it once before.

speaker: ysmera
say: Passage south, should you want it!
words_shown: Passage south, should you want it!

speaker: gil
say: I’ve beds that smell of tar and a fire that smells of fish. Best in the yard.
words_shown: I’ve beds that smell of tar and a fire that smells of fish. Best in the yard.
tone: Wheezy pride, a showman of small things.

speaker: gil
say: The cold lights wait on the slipway at night. Like passengers with no ticket.
words_shown: The cold lights wait on the slipway at night. Like passengers with no ticket.

speaker: gil
say: The shipmaster’s in the tall house with the glass roof. She’ll sell you anything but the north.
words_shown: The shipmaster’s in the tall house with the glass roof. She’ll sell you anything but the north.

speaker: gil
say: It’s colder every week. My knees know before the frost does.
words_shown: It’s colder every week. My knees know before the frost does.

speaker: gil
say: Fifty years I’ve kept this inn. Never had a moon-woman stay the night. Still haven’t.
words_shown: Fifty years I’ve kept this inn. Never had a moon-woman stay the night. Still haven’t.

speaker: gil
say: Yard hands won’t walk the north road now. They say it hums at night.
words_shown: Yard hands won’t walk the north road now. They say it hums at night.
tone: Voice lowered, a tale told by the fire.

speaker: gil
say: She’s stopped selling. The shipmaster. Sat in my inn and drank tea like the rest of us.
words_shown: She’s stopped selling. The shipmaster. Sat in my inn and drank tea like the rest of us.
tone: Amazed and delighted, a little proud.

speaker: gil
say: Door’s on the latch!
words_shown: Door’s on the latch!

speaker: tock
say: That skiff is held together by stubbornness and blue thread. I respect it.
words_shown: That skiff is held together by stubbornness and blue thread. I respect it.

speaker: tock
say: Lights that don’t hang straight have lost their hook, I say.
words_shown: Lights that don’t hang straight have lost their hook, I say.
tone: A shipwright’s certainty, brief. His guess.

speaker: tock
say: Your captain’s at the slip, guarding his lamps from my apprentices. Down by the water.
words_shown: Your captain’s at the slip, guarding his lamps from my apprentices. Down by the water.

speaker: tock
say: New ribs, new keelson, same old ship. Don’t tell her. She’s proud.
words_shown: New ribs, new keelson, same old ship. Don’t tell her. She’s proud.
tone: Fond and conspiratorial, about a ship.

speaker: tock
say: She’ll fly higher now. Not all the way. Nothing lit gets all the way up there.
words_shown: She’ll fly higher now. Not all the way. Nothing lit gets all the way up there.

speaker: tock
say: Don’t touch the scaffolds!
words_shown: Don’t touch the scaffolds!

speaker: pim
say: Moonwort! Real moonwort, from the moon. Nearly from the moon. From very high up.
words_shown: Moonwort! Real moonwort, from the moon. Nearly from the moon. From very high up.
tone: Bright sales patter, backing down as she goes.

speaker: pim
say: Herbs go pale when they miss the sun. Those cold lights look like they miss something worse.
words_shown: Herbs go pale when they miss the sun. Those cold lights look like they miss something worse.
tone: Sweet and a little sad. Her guess.

speaker: pim
say: The shipmaster buys my moonwort for her tea. Tall house, glass roof. She tips badly.
words_shown: The shipmaster buys my moonwort for her tea. Tall house, glass roof. She tips badly.

speaker: pim
say: Everything in my baskets has turned to face north-east. Even the dried ones. That’s new.
words_shown: Everything in my baskets has turned to face north-east. Even the dried ones. That’s new.

speaker: pim
say: My baskets have stopped turning. Mostly. I’m calling that a win.
words_shown: My baskets have stopped turning. Mostly. I’m calling that a win.

speaker: pim
say: Something green for the road?
words_shown: Something green for the road?

speaker: passenger
say: I’ve a ticket south. That ship leaves at dawn. I said that yesterday.
words_shown: I’ve a ticket south. That ship leaves at dawn. I said that yesterday.

speaker: passenger
say: The cold lights came down from the north, like me. I think they’re going home.
words_shown: The cold lights came down from the north, like me. I think they’re going home.
tone: Wistful. A guess she wishes were hers to make.

speaker: passenger
say: The shipmaster sold me this. She’ll sell you one. Tall house, glass roof.
words_shown: The shipmaster sold me this. She’ll sell you one. Tall house, glass roof.

speaker: passenger
say: Everyone’s going south. I’m the only one at this dock going nowhere.
words_shown: Everyone’s going south. I’m the only one at this dock going nowhere.

speaker: passenger
say: Another ship gone. I waved it off. I’m good at waving.
words_shown: Another ship gone. I waved it off. I’m good at waving.
tone: Rueful, a joke at her own expense.

speaker: passenger
say: My house is past the crossroads. I left the door open. I keep thinking about the door.
words_shown: My house is past the crossroads. I left the door open. I keep thinking about the door.
tone: Quiet, haunted by a small thing.

speaker: passenger
say: I gave my ticket to a family with a baby. I’m going home. The door’s still open.
words_shown: I gave my ticket to a family with a baby. I’m going home. The door’s still open.

speaker: passenger
say: Safe road, if there is one.
words_shown: Safe road, if there is one.
tone: Called after them, half a blessing.

speaker: cutter
say: Mind the thorns. They were knee-high yesterday.
words_shown: Mind the thorns. They were knee-high yesterday.
tone: A weary warning. He keeps cutting.

speaker: cutter
say: Nobody planted these, and nobody tends them. They grow like something forgotten.
words_shown: Nobody planted these, and nobody tends them. They grow like something forgotten.

speaker: cutter
say: There’s a moon-woman at the shipyard who knows the north. Ask her. She won’t answer.
words_shown: There’s a moon-woman at the shipyard who knows the north. Ask her. She won’t answer.

speaker: cutter
say: The thorns lean north-east too. Plants aren’t meant to know where anything is.
words_shown: The thorns lean north-east too. Plants aren’t meant to know where anything is.

speaker: cutter
say: Something walked back north last night, all light. The thorns leaned after it like dogs.
words_shown: Something walked back north last night, all light. The thorns leaned after it like dogs.

speaker: cutter
say: Watch your sleeves.
words_shown: Watch your sleeves.

speaker: halcyon
say: Go home.
words_shown: Go home.
tone: A command from inside a light. Calm, far away, not cruel.

speaker: halcyon
say: Go home.
words_shown: Go home.
tone: The same words, quieter. Almost a plea.
